free_tier.stated: No storage cap stated: 'we do not impose strict limits on our users... Some users store and share tens of thousands of images'. Explicitly 'you will never have to worry about your images being removed due to inactivity'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: Images uploaded by both anonymous users and users with free accounts are limited to a file size of 32Mb and maximum dimensions of 10000 × 10000 pixels.

retention.stated: You can upload an unlimited number of images per post, and you will never have to worry about your images being removed due to inactivity.
retention.notes: You can upload an unlimited number of images per post, and you will never have to worry about your images being removed due to inactivity.

egress.terms: Free, unmetered hotlinking, CDN-served, no published bandwidth tier. Only soft pressure: if you use 'a really large amount' of disk/bandwidth without linking back they reserve the right to contact you.

tooling: Documented token API. Their own upload endpoint says 'Please use the official API: https://api.postimages.org/'. ShareX ships a Postimages destination keyed on an account API key from the profile page; npm 'postimages-upload'.
chaining: unverified: the FAQ states unlimited images per post but does not state unlimited free accounts.

extras.agent_focus: image hosts and photo platforms as bulk binary storage: free byte ceilings are high or unlimited because photos are the product, but most re-encode. Crux = which hosts return the original bytes, verified by HEAD/hash, not by marketing copy.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
